svg.title: Crab push pipeline architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram focused on the Crab push pipeline, from Git and crab push entry points through the shared PushPipeline, object storage writes, enterprise auth, cache acceleration, and optional active-active coordination.
svg.text: Focus: git push / crab push, shared PushPipeline, immutable uploads, manifest commit, enterprise auth, and cache acceleration.
Source surfaces: crab/src/cmd/push.rs, crab/src/git/remote_helper.rs, crab/src/git/push_native.rs, crab/src/git/push.rs
crab process: native front-end plus shared push state machine
Shared PushPipeline: immutable data first, mutable manifest last
incremental discover, follow-tags, pre-acquired lock handoff
delegates to the same PushPipeline for correctness
verify local chunks or remote file-index
retire staging or preserve on failure
ACLs, branch policy, scoped upload credentials
dedup query returns verified cached chunk refs
misses fall back without changing correctness
Immutable data becomes durable before refs are exposed through the manifest pointer.
A failed push may leave orphan xorbs/shards/packs for GC, but it must not publish dangling history.
solid green: required client-side push flow
solid rose: required when protected push is enabled
dashed orange: optional cache optimization with safe fallback
